summary: Re-ran the molecular tests for M4-S05 (After-update Apex trigger on Case completing the First Response milestone, plus its test class) after the F-37 rebuild, superseding the stale 2026-09-12T08-24-48Z run that tested the pre-rebuild six-output tree. check-outputs confirmed all 8 declared outputs present, non-empty, and (for the 4 meta XML files) parseable. The always-on xml check parsed all 4 *-meta.xml files. The always-on manifest check recorded skipped-not-applicable per the Apex exception (standards/build-orchestration.md § 5), naming M5-S05 as the step that aggregates the ApexClass/ApexTrigger members. The declared checker (skills/apex/entitlement-apex-hooks/scripts/check_entitlement_apex_hooks.py --manifest-dir artefacts/M4-S05) exited 0 over 4 Apex files (0 ERROR, 0 WARN), versus 3 files in the superseded run — classes/TestDataFactory.cls is now included and clears every rule. The one manual acceptance test was checked against the Given/When/Then shape, found usable, and deferred to skipped_manual[] for the milestone gate. All declared tests passed; status set to tested.
confidence_rationale: Every declared test ran or was correctly classified as manual, both always-on checks completed, and every result came from an exit code this agent observed directly (checker exit 0, check-outputs ok, ElementTree parse success on all 4 meta files). No command test was refused, no manifest exclusion was needed beyond the already-settled Apex exception, and check-outputs reported no missing/empty/malformed output. Per step-tester's Step 7 override of the default rubric.

dimensions_skipped.reason: Design-only build, no org on file. No offline Apex compiler exists in the sf CLI (per agents/_shared/AGENT_CONTRACT.md Gate C row 3), so no compile check or Apex test run was possible at any point in this build, not only at this step.
dimensions_skipped.retry_hint: The org-side verification described in artefacts/M4-S05/deploy-order.md § 7 (debug log at Workflow/INFO after a real deploy) is the human's to run once an org exists; it is out of this agent's scope regardless.

process_observations.observation: The prior stale results.json (run 08-24-48Z) was overwritten rather than trusted, because it recorded only 3 Apex files against a step whose outputs[] had since grown to 8 via a recorded amendment; re-running from a fresh check-outputs call is what surfaced the correct file count of 4.

The F-37 rebuild (classes/TestDataFactory.cls added verbatim from the template) left the checker's domain rules undisturbed: the factory file contains no CaseMilestone reference, so all 8 EAH rules (EAH001-EAH008) are inert on it and the checker's 0 ERROR / 0 WARN result is not masking a rule that silently doesn't apply.

No acceptance-test type this agent can run resolves a cross-file symbol reference, which is exactly the class of defect (F-37: CaseMilestoneServiceTest referencing an unshipped TestDataFactory) that reached a real org before any local check caught it. The checker, xml and manifest tests would all pass again today even if a future edit reintroduced a similar missing-class reference elsewhere in this step's Apex.

The manual acceptance test's Then clause asks the reviewer to confirm CaseMilestoneServiceTest asserts CompletionDate is non-null, but does not ask the reviewer to confirm the newly-added classes/TestDataFactory.cls is itself a byte-identical template copy (deploy-order.md § 0 makes that claim; this agent did not independently diff the two files, since Step 4 of its own playbook does not call for it and it is outside the declared acceptance_tests).
M4-S05 is now tested; the next step in the loop is documentation.
process_observations.followup_reason: because decisions.md and traceability.md do not yet record F-37, the rebuild, or the outputs[] amendment, and build-doc-keeper is the agent that updates them after a step reaches tested.
